operatorBoundaries.title: Balance and feature placement stay mediated
operatorBoundaries.reason: Agents may gather evidence and record options, but may not decide balance targets, body-build taxonomy, feature placement, or new row mechanics.

operatorBoundaries.title: No explicit content expansion
operatorBoundaries.reason: Autonomous work is limited to SFW mechanics, UI, accessibility, localization, documentation, tests, and content-tier-safe architecture.

operatorBoundaries.title: Release and legal actions stay mediated
operatorBoundaries.reason: Commit, push, publishing, public network actions, final device acceptance, and legal or licensing conclusions require the operator.

lanes.title: UI Accessibility Localization Regressions
lanes.objective: Fix demonstrated UI regressions and harden keyboard, ARIA, locale parity, overflow, and supported viewport behavior without redesigning the interaction model.

acceptanceCriteria: No new hardcoded high-traffic UI labels are introduced.
Interactive controls retain accessible names and focus behavior.

containsAll: Maintained locales expose matching translation keys

nonClaims: Does not substitute automated checks for final physical-device or human screen-reader acceptance.
Does not redesign controls without playtest evidence.

lanes.title: Mod Public Context Examples
lanes.objective: Harden permission-gated public narrative context and trusted-local narrative/structural examples without adding an LLM or network dependency to core gameplay.

acceptanceCriteria: Public context is bounded, serializable, versioned, and permission-gated.
Public unit summaries omit compatibility anatomy and containment internals.
Core gameplay remains deterministic without a model or network call.

containsAll: Narrative modules receive bounded serializable public context

nonClaims: Does not add a remote service or model dependency.
Does not expose raw saves, credentials, or hidden compatibility fields.

lanes.title: Multi Interaction Regression Hardening
lanes.objective: Add focused coverage and fix demonstrated actor-target-intent regressions without inventing semantics for unresolved unequal group shapes.

acceptanceCriteria: Combat target picks follow the documented mark-and-confirm flow.
Selection cleanup remains correct across containment, defeat, movement, dismissal, and load.
Unresolved group semantics remain explicitly rejected.
nonClaims: Does not define new many-to-many mechanics.

lanes.title: Deterministic Map Invariants
lanes.objective: Add tests and narrow helpers for start safety, traversal metadata, and deterministic overlays while preserving sparse world generation and save compatibility.

acceptanceCriteria: New persistent world behavior is seeded and reproducible.
Mutable deltas do not alter deterministic base generation.
No gameplay code depends on materializing the full world.
nonClaims: Does not choose new balance targets.
Does not replace the sparse coordinate architecture.
